hypotheses.justification: The statement and proof need i only as a morphism: splitKernelConj and splitKernelProductIso do not require i to preserve multiplication. The group calculation can be proved using splitKernelConj_lift_comp_i, whose statement and proof require neither [IsMonHom i] nor [IsMonHom e], followed by the group laws. The argument remains valid in degenerate cases since it uses only the stated group-object laws and pullback property.

The product isomorphism and restricted conjugation are defined for an arbitrary section e satisfying he; neither requires e to preserve multiplication. The proof's conjugation readback splitKernelConj_lift_comp_i holds without [IsMonHom e], so the remaining equality follows from group laws on the morphisms. No degenerate case requires multiplicativity of e.
